dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale-white fringes along the exterior margins of the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Fine, dense, horizontal dark-on-light barring across the posterior neck region.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced scalloped appearance resulting from wide, high-contrast light-colored fringes on all visible dorsal and wing feathers.
